messages:
elaine: Thanks for joining the all-hands — quick thread for the items we promised to circulate + a tiny action grid. Reply if you want a different owner.

ops-bot: Recording + slides: https://redwood.cloud/ah/1777777777/recording · https://drive.redwood/teams/all-hands/1777777777/slides

maria: TL;DR doc uploaded and pinned. I added a short "open follow-ups" table in the doc.

joel: Dedicated GA timing: still aiming for early Q3; will run staged rollouts. I own the rollout checklist and canary metrics. ETA: 2024-05-13.

anya: Observability retention asks — customers asked for 90/180/365-day tiers and per-route cost history. I will model storage costs and propose opt-in migrations. Owner: anya. ETA: 2024-05-04.

devex: SDK backward compatibility question: we keep major-semver guarantees. Devex will publish a short migration recipe repo (py/ts) and a compatibility CI job. Owner: devex. ETA: 2024-04-29.

maria: Compact action grid (copied from the doc):
```
- Joel: publish Dedicated rollout checklist + canary metrics (due 2024-05-13)
- Anya: retention tiers + cost model + opt-in plan (due 2024-05-04)
- Devex: migration recipes + compat CI (due 2024-04-29)
- Maria: publish TL;DR & pin assets (done)
```

joel: Ack — will post the checklist link here once it lands in the rollout repo.

anya: Starting the retention cost calc today; will share numbers in this thread.

devex: Kicking off migration-examples repo; will add tests and examples by the ETA.

elaine: If your question from the live Q&A is missing, reply here and we27ll route it to the right owner. If any ETA is impossible, call it out so we can re-prioritize. Thanks everyone for the quick follow-up :sparkles:
